description: Enumerate up to 10000 known subdomains of a single domain (the upstream API's hard cap; check the "truncated_at_upstream_cap" response field for whether more may exist), with first-/last-seen timestamps per subdomain. Use this for attack-surface mapping on a target organisation's apex domain. Can return thousands of rows — paginate. Do NOT use this for searching newly-registered domains by pattern (use `domain_and_subdomain_discovery`) or for processing many apex domains at once (use `bulk_subdomain_lookup`).

domain_name.description: Domain name to lookup subdomains for.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-500, default 500).

next_page_token.description: IMPORTANT: To fetch the next page, copy the "next_page_token" value from the previous response and pass it here. Do not use "search_after" or any other parameter name - only "next_page_token" is accepted.

name: subdomain_lookup
